design: L19 widened 32->64 (same as ACR); L28 kept official 256 (not slimmed); everything else official
judgment: Per pre-registered branches: WIDEN small AP 0.109599 < ACR 0.110785 by 1.07% relative (necessity branch marginally triggered), but the paired bootstrap ACR-vs-WIDEN delta CIs cross zero on both all and small AP. Honest verdict: contributions of width vs asymmetric reallocation are NOT separable at this sample size. P2 widening is the dominant driver of the small-object gain (+6.1% alone); asymmetric reallocation achieves the same accuracy envelope with 213,440 fewer parameters (-7.9% vs WIDEN, -6.45% vs official) and slightly fewer GMACs (5.579 vs 5.665). Reallocation is therefore an efficiency contribution, not an accuracy necessity. Thesis narrative updated accordingly; no variants will be run to force separation.
